main_text.p: ditio. Theophylactus Chryfoftomi abbreuiator, eandem diftinctionem expreffit ad Heb. 2. & 9. & commemorat Bafilium quoque ita diftinxiffe. Vnde & Chryfoftomus homil.39. in 1.ad Cor. in illud Apoftoli, quod omnes in Christo viui-ficentur, aperte negat id accipi poffe de iuftitia omnium, quafi quicunque in Adamo peccatores coftituti funt, in Christo iuftitia donati funt. Ex his perfpicuum eft, cui fententiæ Chryfoftomus, Theophylactus, Bafilius aliique patres accedant.

Augufti-nus.In Auguftino citando nefcio vafriciem, an craffitiem, in aduerfario culpe. Librum inscripfit Augustt. de falso sibi impositis articulis, quorum primus erat quod ipsi falso imponebatur (quemadmodum etiam ab æmulis nobis falso imponitur hodie) ac si doceret Dominum noftrum Iesum Christum non pro omnium hominum redemtione esse pafsum. Ergo inquis Auguftini iudicio falfa & profana opinio est, Chriftum non esse passum pro redemtione omnium.

page.notes: Marginal note at left: "Augufti-nus." Catchword and signature not visible. The word "pro" in the second column line is partly obscured; readings "vafriciem" and "culpe" follow the scan. Lower part of page is damaged by a fold and show-through.
